hypothesis: The official pitcher as-of counter mixes R and F outcomes inside the current season. Because the hidden evaluation is dominated by R and the F outcome regime changes sharply, replacing the mixed current-season state with an R-only state may expose a goal-scale structural ceiling that ordinary row-feature changes cannot recover.

privileged_oracle_warning.purpose: Measure whether R/F current-state deconvolution has enough structural headroom to justify a separate legal row-local estimator.

state_definition.aggregate_state: Use the official row-local asof_pitcher_n and asof_pitcher_success_rate minus the frozen state at the end of the preceding season, exactly as E14.
state_definition.oracle_r_state: For each historical R validation row, count and sum only earlier R rows for the same pitcher in the same season, using the official historical sequence.
state_definition.prior: R control_success mean from seasons strictly before the validation season.
state_definition.correction: On R rows only, exact-C plus gamma times (R-only EB current-season rate minus aggregate EB current-season rate). F rows remain exact-C.

semantic_audit.comparison: Official E14 current-season deltas versus counts and outcomes of all earlier same-season pitcher rows in historical file order.
semantic_audit.on_fail: Declare the oracle invalid and close without metrics or 2022+ labels.

selection_order: maximum minimum full-score gain across 2020 and 2021

headroom_gate.on_fail: Close the R/F state-deconvolution axis without reading 2022+ labels.
headroom_gate.on_pass: Preregister and build a separate legal estimator that predicts the R-specific state from only current-row official fields and completed-season frozen state; the oracle itself remains permanently ineligible.
